From: irene_choi@redwood.com

Date: 2026-10-07T10:10:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Deploy v5.2 went live — huge throughput drop and answer regressions

Quick findings from ops:
- Telemetry: CPU-side decode queuing increased after node-level kernel selection switched to int8-q3 on rollout. Throughput per-GPU dropped ~40% for long sequences (see attached csv).
- Hot path: requests with >1,024 tokens show KV eviction churn and subsequent re-computation on model side.
- Error profile: 502s come from worker OOM retries followed by gateway timeouts; not a networking flake.

Recommendation: 1) Hot rollback to v5.1 with q2 quant profile for Sienna while we investigate; 2) Enable temporary routing to Dedicated pools with larger KV memory for long contexts.

I can trigger rollback once Lukas approves.

Irene
Irene Choi
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-10-09T18:45:00-07:00
Subject: Executive brief: Sienna Health post-rollback status & next steps

Elaine / Alex — brief summary following rollback and investigation: 
- Timeline: rollback to v5.1 + q2 executed 2026-10-07 11:16 PDT; Sienna p99 and error rate returned to baseline by 11:38.
- Root cause (interim): aggressive kernel selection for q3 on long-context workloads caused increased decode CPU load and KV churn, leading to worker retries and timeouts. This is a modelpack+runtime interaction for sequences >1,024 tokens.
- Remediation actions completed:
  • Disabled q3 auto-selection for A100 pools handling Sienna long-context traffic.
  • Added a routing rule to pin long-context requests to Dedicated pools with expanded KV memory.
  • Started a focused perf regression test plan to tune q3 kernels for long-context workloads (ETA: 10 business days).

Compensation: Per Lukas' approval, Redwood will apply a 1-week service credit to the October invoice and provide a technical readout once regression tests complete.

Next steps for the PM/Eng review:
1) Full post-mortem (owner: Irene) due 2026-10-14.
2) Kernel selection policy change proposal (owner: Performance Eng) due 2026-10-12.
3) Customer-facing writeup with timelines (owner: Ben) due 2026-10-11.

Irene has attached the preliminary traces and the MAP (mutual action plan). Happy to jump on a postmortem call with your execs if you'd like.

-ben
Ben Carter
VP, Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
